query:
SELECT s.id, s.saleDate, s.saleType, s.finalAmount, s.paymentStatus, r.id as receivableId, r.status as receivableStatus, r.totalAmount, r.receivedAmount
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN receivables r ON s.id = r.saleId
LEFT JOIN partners p ON s.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Rian%'
ORDER BY s.saleDate DESC
LIMIT 5
